para.text: The Particle Transport pane is on the
dialog box. It is used to define the Particle Transport (PRT) models in MODFLOW 6 models.

There can be multiple PRT models associated with a single groundwater flow model. The user can define PRT models by setting the number of PRT models to a value greater than or equal to one. The user can then specify the names of the model(s). Model names can be up to 16 ASCII characters in length and are not case sensitive. Model names can not contain blank characters. Model Names must be unique.
In addition to the model name, the user can also specify whether a model is "used". If the model is not "used", input for it will not be created when running MODFLOW 6.
For each PRT model, a separate
will be created in which the properties of the PRT model are specified.
